title: Narration L009 — SC04 Disappearing (Susan, take 1)
line: So I made it true. I stopped going. Muted the group chat. Skipped the birthdays. And every morning the mirror agreed with them, my foundation caking into every line I owned, until I looked exactly like the word he used.
